name: Cheng Brain Tumor MRI Detection
description: Cheng brain-tumor MRI detection: 3,064 T1-weighted contrast-enhanced brain MRI slices from 233 patients, three tumor types (meningioma, glioma, pituitary). Tumor bounding boxes derived from the authors' pixel tumor masks; patient-grouped train/val/test split (no patient shared across splits). CC BY 4.0. Source: Cheng, Jun (2017). brain tumor dataset. figshare. DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.1512427.v8. Attribution required.
